requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

2906-4399-4770--228.easyPrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
2906-4399-4770--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Rakdos.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2906-4399-4770--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2023-3755-4518-4927.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7354-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7354-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-2842-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Artist ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1170-3581-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3581-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5315-5705--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5315-5705--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2301-2946-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2301-2946-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-3443-4359.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-4359.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-4359.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

232-1308-5778-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Priest of Urabrask that are 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask tokens enter, they each trigger, adding six {R}.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Appa trigger, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Appa that are 1/1.
Put both Appa tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Appa tokens' enter-the-battlefield ability trigger, airbending Appa with one trigger and nothing with the other.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 7.
232-1308-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

2558-2921-7422--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2921-7422--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1765-2440-5223-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-5223-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

1824-2530-3497-5061.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3497-5061.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-3497-5061.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3368-4668-6974.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least four cards this turn.
3368-4668-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {U}{R} due to Heliod. Choose its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any other mode as desired.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Heliod, copying Ashling's Command with the fourth mode targeting yourself and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating two Treasure tokens and performing the action of the other chosen mode.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

465-2511-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

465-2150-5686.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-5326-7193.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Omni-Changeling and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Omni-Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Omni-Changeling to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Omni-Changeling enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Omni-Changeling by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2374-2841-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2374-2841-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3197-4321-6451-6934.description:
Activate Greta by paying {G} and sacrificing a Food, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Food by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

229-5220-6900.description:
Cast Endless One either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Endless One enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3372-4050-6006-6791.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-6006-6791.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2921-3168-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2921-3168-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-3168-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

826-2905-3899-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-2905-3899-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Pestermite.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Pestermite.
When Pestermite dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Pestermite from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pestermite enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1698-3260-3540-6121.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-6121.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-6121.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

1909-4486-5724.notablePrerequisites: Sage of the Maze does not have summoning sickness.
1909-4486-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Sage of the Maze.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

225-2034-2757-5552.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least ten permanents.
You control a basic Forest.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-2034-2757-5552.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Ojer Kaslem, untapping the Forest.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

2178-2511-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2511-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Eldrazi token.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2047-5443.manaNeeded: {W}{U}, plus an additional {W}{U} per opponent as necessary
2047-5443.notablePrerequisites: The number of creatures on the battlefield is equal to or greater than eight minus the number of Clue tokens you control.
2047-5443.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Officious Interrogation by paying {W}{U} plus an additional {W}{U} as necessary, creating at least eight Clue artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

1439-1636-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
You have attacked this turn.
1439-1636-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Protean Raider by paying {1}{U}{R}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Protean Raider.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Protean Raider into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Protean Raider to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

876-2043-2776.description:
Float at least {10}.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {7}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Doubling Cube that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Doubling Cube token.
Repeat from step 2 using the Doubling Cube token instead.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

773-1409-5184.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Galazeth Prismari.
773-1409-5184.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

785-5016.notablePrerequisites:
Soul Link attached to Spitemare.
You have a way to give Spitemare indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Spitemare.
785-5016.description:
Give Spitemare indestructible, and then deal damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare and Soul Link's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Soul Link trigger, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Spitemare trigger, dealing that much damage to itself.
Spitemare and Soul Link's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve both Soul Link triggers, causing you to gain life equal to twice the damage dealt.
Repeat from step 4.

2275-4126.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2275-4126.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to draw a card due to Nefarious Lich.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-1369-3814-4893.notablePrerequisites: Two lands that tap for blue.
1247-1369-3814-4893.description:
Pay {U} using Quicksilver Elemental to target Pili-Pala.
Pay {U} using Quicksilver Elemental to target Argothian Elder.
Tap Quicksilver Elemental for at least {C} {U}.
Pay {U} to untap Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat.

1424-2617.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Midnight Guard.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
1424-2617.description:
Tap Midnight Guard to create a 1/1 elf.
Midnight Guard triggers, untapping itself because due to the creature ETB trigger.
Repeat to make infinite elves.

1702-2365-3212.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Expropriate on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Expropriate, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {5}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

2228-2557-2741-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control another creature.
2228-2557-2741-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on an opponent's creature and drawing a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
The Snakes enter the battlefield, triggering Essence Warden twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat until your opponent control no creatures.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on a Snake token you control and drawing a card.
The Snake dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Hapatra triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
The Snakes enter the battlefield, triggering Essence Warden twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 5.

224-1046-3177.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
224-1046-3177.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.
